strings.Each pair starts with an authentic Nike: Each pair starts with an authentic Nike Air Force 1, prepped and primed as a canvas. The design is hand-drawn, hand-mixed, and hand-applied — no digital printing, no transfers, no shortcuts.
strings.We seal every piece with automotive-grad: We seal every piece with automotive-grade clear coats, making the artwork crack-proof, waterproof, and built to outlast the shoe itself.
strings.We work exclusively with Top Grain Lambs: We work exclusively with Top Grain Lambskin — selected for its buttery hand-feel, natural grain texture, and ability to hold paint at a microscopic level.
strings.Each jacket is hand-constructed and then: Each jacket is hand-constructed and then hand-painted over 60+ hours. The result is a one-of-one garment that functions as both outerwear and a permanent art piece.
strings.Describe what you want. We'll hand-paint: Describe what you want. We'll hand-paint it into existence. Every commission is a private collaboration between you and a single dedicated artisan.

strings.How long does standard production and sh: How long does standard production and shipping take?
Every item is crafted entirely to order. Production is 1–2 weeks for footwear, 6–8 weeks for standard size leatherwear, and 8–12 weeks for tailored (made-to-measure) orders. Shipping is complimentary on orders over €300; otherwise, rates vary by region. Delivery takes 4–15 business days depending on your location.
strings.Is the hand-painting durable? Will it cr: Is the hand-painting durable? Will it crack or wash off?
strings.We work exclusively with professional le: We work exclusively with professional leather acrylics mixed with advanced flexible bonding agents. Each piece is sealed with a scratch-resistant, water-repellent UV protective varnish. They are fully wearable and highly durable under normal conditions.
strings.Can I return or exchange my order?: Can I return or exchange my order?
strings.Footwear sales are final once the correc: Footwear sales are final once the correct size and design have been delivered. If we made an error — wrong size shipped or incorrect design — we will make corrections at no additional cost. Leatherwear is not a final sale: for made-to-measure orders, we build and ship a plain, unpainted "test" jacket first so you can verify fit and quality. Once approved, you ship it back and our artisans complete the tailoring and custom artwork. However, we cannot offer a return on a handmade, hand-painted jacket if the order was fulfilled exactly as requested.
strings.Do you accept private custom commissions: Do you accept private custom commissions?
strings.Yes. We accept a limited number of bespo: Yes. We accept a limited number of bespoke commissions each month. You can pitch your vision through the custom commission form on our Contact page, and our master artisans will collaborate with you to create your 1-of-1 masterpiece.
strings.We hand-paint every sneaker. We hand-cut: We hand-paint every sneaker. We hand-cut, hand-stitch, and hand-paint every jacket. Art meets tailoring.
strings.Custom Patike is an atelier built on two: Custom Patike is an atelier built on two disciplines: hand-painting and leather tailoring. Every sneaker is hand-painted on an authentic Nike Air Force 1 — 40+ hours of brushwork per pair. Every leather jacket is handmade from Top Grain Lambskin — hand-cut, hand-stitched, and hand-painted by a single artisan. We don't print. We build wearable art, one piece at a time.
strings.Each pair begins with an authentic Nike: Each pair begins with an authentic Nike Air Force 1, prepped and primed as a canvas. We hand-mix every pigment and apply it brush by brush — building depth through dozens of translucent layers over 40+ hours.
strings.The result is a surface you can feel. Te: The result is a surface you can feel. Textured brushwork, visible technique, sealed with UV-resistant varnish that outlasts the shoe itself.
strings.Our leather jackets are not just painted: Our leather jackets are not just painted — they are tailored. Each one is hand-cut from Top Grain Lambskin, stitched by a single craftsman, and then hand-painted over 60+ hours.
strings.Available in standard sizes (S–XL) or ma: Available in standard sizes (S–XL) or made to your exact body measurements. The tailoring and the art are inseparable — one garment, one artisan, start to finish.
strings.Beyond our standard sizing, we offer a f: Beyond our standard sizing, we offer a full made-to-measure experience. Submit your measurements — chest, waist, shoulder, sleeve, back length — and your jacket is cut and stitched to fit your exact body before the painting begins.
strings.No two bodies are the same. Your jacket: No two bodies are the same. Your jacket shouldn't be either. Made-to-measure orders include a pre-production fit consultation and an 8–12 week turnaround.
strings.Every jacket offers the option of a hand: Every jacket offers the option of a hand-painted personal signature — a name, a date, or a short phrase — permanently applied to the leather in the same paint and technique as the primary artwork.
strings.This is not embroidery or engraving. It: This is not embroidery or engraving. It is brushwork, by the same hand that painted the rest of the garment.
strings.Every brushstroke is applied by hand. No: Every brushstroke is applied by hand. No machines paint our work. Every leather jacket is hand-cut, hand-stitched, and handmade in our atelier.
strings.Standard sizes with a precise size guide: Standard sizes with a precise size guide, or made-to-measure for a garment cut to your exact body.
strings.Angelus leather paint, UV-sealed with Li: Angelus leather paint, UV-sealed with Liquitex varnish. 40–60+ hours of brushwork per piece. Crack-proof. Waterproof. Permanent.
strings.Each piece is entirely handmade and hand: Each piece is entirely handmade and handpainted by our master artisans.
strings.From the avenues of Munich to the galler: From the avenues of Munich to the galleries of Milan, Custom Patike collectors carry their one-of-one canvases out of the archives and onto the streets. A global collective of fine art, individual expression, and tailored streetwear.
